measurements.name: specimen_dispersion_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r between analytical Turing σ(k) and a linearized Fourier step on the real-eigenvalue band
measurements.reference_source: Turing 1952 dispersion relation; value is the solver residual against that curve, not a copy of the reference

measurements.name: specimen_dispersion_rmse
measurements.method: RMSE of numerical versus analytical growth rates σ(k)
measurements.reference_source: Zero would be a perfect match; the solver leaves a small splitting residual

measurements.name: ocellus_wavelength_um
measurements.method: Radial FFT peak of the saturated Schnakenberg field, converted by the 104.2 µm formula-wavelength unit
measurements.reference_source: Formula λ_c = 2π/k_c. The realized peak sits slightly off onset, so value ≠ reference

measurements.name: specimen_contour_aspect_ratio
measurements.method: Bounding-box width/height of the dark fossil body segmented from the Brussels mount
measurements.reference_source: Reference is the same measurement on the species-gallery life reconstruction, a different image

measurements.name: specimen_orientation_ks
measurements.method: Two-sample KS statistic of Sobel orientations, fossil crop versus last GIF frame
measurements.reference_source: KS = 0 would mean identical orientation samples; the overlay does not reproduce every bone edge

measurements.name: pattern_versus_equal_diffusion_std_ratio
measurements.method: std(u) of the Turing run divided by std(u) of the equal-diffusion negative control
measurements.reference_source: Equal diffusion is the Turing-negative control; ratio near 1 would mean the control still patterned

measurements.name: pattern_versus_ablated_autocatalysis_std_ratio
measurements.method: std(u) of the full model divided by std(u) after dropping u²v autocatalysis
measurements.reference_source: Ablation removes the Schnakenberg feedback; residual std is relaxation, not spots

measurements.name: wavelength_sweep_spearman_r
measurements.method: Spearman rank correlation of realized λ against Dv/Du over the sweep
measurements.reference_source: Zero would be no rank association; the sweep is the expressivity check
